page.layout: One page of text. Top: running head "HABAKUK" with page number "224" at the upper left. Below it, a centred italic heading. Then a paragraph, a sequence of outline lines (headings I and II with numbered and lettered subdivisions), and a catchword "PERI-" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Præmittitur hic titulus totius libri, exhibens nomen vatis, ejus titulum, quo munus ejus indicatur, argumentum, & argumenti originem.
Post hanc inscriptionem occurrit querela aliqua expo-stulatoria, quam ad tribunal Dei defert, cujus exhibet
main_text.l: 1. De non exaudità vociferatione fidelium vi op-pressorum. verf. 2. a
2. De salute dudum speratâ, ast necdum allatâ. verf. 2. b
II. Confirmationem caussæ[?] per rationes à corruptione temporis defumptas, quibus accusat impios ex Judæis
2. In specie corrupti fori, ubi notat.

page.notes: The sub-markers under "c." appear as hand-set marks resembling "ɔ." and "ɔɔ."; they are transcribed as "1." and "2." and are uncertain. "caussæ" is doubtful: the letters are blurred, so the word is marked [?]. The "à" and "exaudità" accents are reproduced as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The running head is spaced letters, printed here as HABAKUK.
